{{Top|Leg}}
A '''true-fleck brain implant''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] that was an essential part of the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation|Neuro-Saav Corporation's]] [[Hifold Sensory Package|Hifold Sensory Package]]. Combined with artificial [[Hypergleamum gland|hypergleamum glands]] implanted into the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], this increased the brain's capability to handle the extra input of data supplied by the Hifold system and keep everything organized.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
